# Source PDF Layout Reference

Geometry measured from the club's leaderboard export (August Weekend Medal 2026,
generated by the club scoring system). All values are PDF points, origin
top-left, page 612 × 792 (US Letter).

Used by `../scripts/merge_leaderboard.py`. If the club changes its export, these
must be re-derived — the method is at the bottom of this document.

## Page anatomy

| Region | y range | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Club header | 14.25 – ~105 | Logos + **vector outline** title artwork. Identical on every page. Preserved verbatim. |
| Division banner | 120.75 – 149.25 | Page 1 only. Bordered white box. |
| Column header band | 157.5 – 191.25 | Page 1 only. Dark fill, height 33.75. |
| Rows (page 1) | from 191.25 | 16.5 per row, 35 rows per page. |
| Rows (continuation) | from 113.25 | **No banner, no repeated column header.** |
| Footer band | after last row + 0.75 | Height 26.25, dark fill, centred white text. |

The header artwork is not text. `pdftotext` returns nothing for the title, date,
or "Round 1 Leaderboard" — they are vector paths. This is why the template-reuse
approach works: copy the page, replace only what is below y = 108.

## Table geometry

Column edges (vertical rules, 0.75 wide):

```
11.25 | 74.25 | 349.5 | 420.0 | 492.0 | 600.75
      Pos       Player   ToPar   Total    Purse
```

| Column | Alignment | x | Font size |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pos. | centred | 42.75 | 10.5 |
| Player | **left** | 76.27 | 10.5 |
| To Par Net | centred | 384.75 | **9.0** |
| Total Net | centred | 456.0 | 10.5 |
| Purse | centred | 546.375 | 10.5 |

The To Par column being 9pt while everything else is 10.5pt is easy to miss and
visibly wrong if you get it that way.

## Text baselines

Offsets from the top of the containing row or band:

| Element | Offset | Size |
|---|---|---|
| Banner text | +20.25 (x = 23.25, left) | 12.75 |
| `Pos.` / `Player` / `Purse` headings | +21.0 | 11.55 |
| `To Par` heading | +14.25 | 9.0 |
| `Net` sub-heading (To Par) | +25.5 | 9.0 |
| `Total` heading | +13.5 | 11.55 |
| `Net` heading (Total) | +28.5 | 11.55 |
| Row values | +11.25 | 10.5 |
| Row To Par value | +10.5 | 9.0 |
| Footer text | +17.25 | 11.55 |

## Colours

| Use | RGB | Hex |
|---|---|---|
| Row background (odd) | `(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)` | `#ffffff` |
| Row background (even) | `(0.961, 0.961, 0.961)` | `#f5f5f5` |
| Borders / rules | `(0.827, 0.855, 0.871)` | `#d3dade` |
| Header + footer band | `(0.243, 0.243, 0.267)` | `#3e3e44` |
| Banner text | `(0.243, 0.271, 0.286)` | `#3e4549` |
| Player names | `(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)` | `#000000` |
| Other cell values | `(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)` | `#333333` |

Row shading alternates across the **whole field**, not per page — row 36 at the
top of page 2 continues the alternation from row 35.

## Font

Single embedded font: `IBMPlexSans-Regular`, TrueType CID subset, Identity-H,
159 glyphs / 64 mapped characters.

Available characters:

```
 '()+-.0123456789:ABCDEFGHIJKLMNPQRSTWabcdefghijklmnoprstuvwxyz£
```

**Not available:** `O` `U` `V` `X` `Y` `Z` `q` `,` and most punctuation.

Bold-looking text in the header is vector artwork, not a bold font weight. There
is no bold font in the document — do not try to synthesise one.

## Re-deriving these values

If the export format changes, re-measure rather than guess:

```python
import fitz
doc = fitz.open("Male Leaderboard.pdf")
page = doc[0]

# text: exact baselines, sizes, colours
for block in page.get_text("dict")["blocks"]:
    if block["type"] == 1:
        continue
    for line in block["lines"]:
        for span in line["spans"]:
            print(repr(span["text"]), span["size"],
                  span["origin"], hex(span["color"]))

# fills and rules: row height, band positions, column edges
for drawing in page.get_drawings():
    print(drawing["rect"], drawing.get("fill"), drawing.get("width"))
```

Useful cross-checks:

- Column bands: histogram span `bbox[0]` values to find where columns start.
- Font coverage: `fitz.Font(fontbuffer=...)` then `has_glyph(ord(c))`.
- Header preservation: render both PDFs and pixel-diff the top 150px with
  Pillow's `ImageChops.difference(...).getbbox() is None`.
